de_novo.years_note: 3 years essential, 10, 40 and 80 years if the budget allows (declared before the runs); 10, 40 and 80 years for the main case only; the 40- and 80-year tables come from a second machine running the repository's run command
de_novo.fit: stage 1: 4 fibers at 0.9, 0.97, 1.04, 1.12 times a start value; stage 2: 8 fibers at 1/1.02, 1, 1.02 times the stage-1 inverse; logistic regression on log10(m)
de_novo.seed_rule: sha256 of the manifest seed, case, size, years, phase, m and fiber index

de_novo_fibers.declared: 2026-11-21, before any run of this design; the first design (entry de_novo) and its saved tables are unchanged
de_novo_fibers.same_as_de_novo: target (10% of regions with 5 * M >= 3 * (W + M) at the end of the lifespan), model, parameters, 32 regions with closed ends, cases, 360-day years, units, statement rule, bootstrap over whole fibers, seed rule
de_novo_fibers.sampling_unit: the fiber, in the fit and in the validation

fibers.order: fibers per stage-1 value, per stage-2 value, validation

de_novo_fibers.start: draft and full: the fitted m of the last attempt in results/de-novo-rates.csv for the same case and lifespan, if there is one; otherwise, and always at the quick size (another model), the stage-0 probe of the first design
de_novo_fibers.stage1: fibers per value at 0.92, 0.97, 1.03, 1.09 times the start value; extended by a value 1.25 times below the lowest or above the highest until the shares of affected regions enclose 10%, at most 4 times
de_novo_fibers.stage2: fibers per value at 1/1.03, 1, 1.03 times the stage-1 estimate (the logistic inverse at 10%; if that fit has no positive slope or its inverse lies outside the stage-1 values, the geometric mean of the stage-1 values)
de_novo_fibers.fit: logistic regression of the region indicator on log10(m) through all fit points for the point estimate; its 95% interval is the percentile interval of 1,999 refits on resamples of whole fibers within each fit point; a resample whose fit does not converge or has no positive slope counts at both ends of the interval; a point fit without positive slope, or whose inverse lies outside the range of the fit points, is a failed calibration (added on the same day, after a quick-size development run extrapolated far outside the fit points; before any draft or full run and before the coverage experiment)
de_novo_fibers.validation: validation fibers at the frozen m; compatible if the 95% percentile bootstrap interval over fibers of the share of affected regions contains 0.10 and at least min_affected_fibers fibers hold an affected region; otherwise 'outside' (interval excludes 0.10) or 'too few affected fibers'; the Wilson interval is reported and assumes independent regions; no band
de_novo_fibers.refit: once, if the first validation is not compatible: three new stage-2 values of stage-2 size at 1/1.03, 1, 1.03 times the m fitted through all points, a fit through all points, and a new validation cohort; if that is not compatible either, the calibration failed; all rows kept
de_novo_fibers.statement: as de_novo; with fewer than 20 affected regions or fewer than min_affected_fibers affected fibers no statement
de_novo_fibers.phases: fibers-stage0, fibers-stage1, fibers-stage2, fibers-stage2-a2, fibers-validation, fibers-validation-a2 (no fiber or checkpoint of the first design is reused)
de_novo_fibers.outputs: de-novo-fibers-rates.csv, -fit.csv, -summary.csv, -regions.csv, -zones.csv, -segments.csv; m written with full precision

length_control.statement: 'chain length matters' if the 95% fiber-bootstrap intervals of types per affected region of the 32-region validation cohort (last attempt) and the 128-region cohort do not overlap, else 'no difference seen'; no statement if either cohort has fewer than min_affected_fibers affected fibers (its interval would rest on too few fibers)

de_novo_fibers.cost_estimate: about 0.13 CPU-seconds per region and year with Numba (second machine, Intel Xeon 2.3 GHz: 170 s per 32-region fiber at 40 years, 330 s at 80 years)

reference_kind: Authors' numerical means (1C) and ensemble-mean profiles (2E), converted to long CSV. See fetch.py.
